tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Primary page background — warm linen. The grounded neutral the rest of the palette sits on.

tokens.name: surface-000
tokens.usage: Elevated surfaces: cards, product photography backdrops, modals.

tokens.name: surface-900
tokens.usage: Deep sections — footers, hero bands, dark feature blocks.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface-100 / surface-000. 11.3:1 contrast on surface-100 — passes AA and AAA.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary / supporting text on light surfaces: 7.3:1 on `surface-100`, 8.7:1 on `surface-000`. Also the colour for input borders and focus rings. Not for text on `accent-warm` (4.33:1) — use `accent-warm-ink`.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on surface-900. 11.3:1 contrast.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and subtle separators on light surfaces only — 1.25:1 on `surface-100`, 1.5:1 on `surface-000`, so it can't be the only thing marking an input or control (those need 3:1). Use `ink-muted` (7.3:1) for input borders, focus rings and anything a customer must see.

tokens.name: brand-primary
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, links, headings — the grounded, editorial anchor of the brand.

tokens.name: brand-primary-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icon colour on brand-primary fills.

tokens.name: accent-bloom
tokens.usage: The signature 'bloom' accent — exact match to the MBE logo pink. A rare, deliberate moment (~5% of any page): one CTA, a badge, a hover state. Never a background, a large shape or a text colour on light surfaces (2.7:1 on `surface-100`, 3.2:1 on `surface-000`).

tokens.name: accent-bloom-ink
tokens.usage: Text/icon colour on accent-bloom fills — 4.25:1, which passes only for large text (24px+, or bold 19px+). Set bloom button labels at bold 19px or larger; never put small text on the pink at all. White on bloom (3.18:1) is likewise large/bold only.

tokens.name: accent-warm
tokens.usage: Secondary accent — tags, highlights, hover states, illustration fills. Text on it: `accent-warm-ink` only (6.7:1). Not `ink-muted` (4.33:1), white (2.0:1) or cream (1.7:1). Never put peach and pink next to each other as the only distinction (1.6:1).

tokens.name: accent-warm-ink
tokens.usage: Text/icon colour on accent-warm fills — 6.7:1 contrast.

tokens.name: utility-white
tokens.usage: Pure white for print production and photography whites, distinct from surface-000's UI role.

tokens.name: utility-black
tokens.usage: Pure black — reserved for print production (rich black, registration), rarely used in UI since ink already reads as a near-black.

families.sans: "Gill Sans Nova", "Gill Sans MT", "Gill Sans", Calibri, "Trebuchet MS", sans-serif

styles.name: accent-lg
styles.usage: The logo's own weight of expression — a hero moment on a landing page, a signature flourish. Short strings only: a name, a single word.

styles.name: accent-md
styles.usage: Pull-quotes, section dividers, a handwritten-feel annotation next to a product. Never body copy, never more than a short phrase.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tightest gaps — icon-to-label, inline tags.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Compact padding, gaps between related small elements.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Default padding inside cards and buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gaps between distinct components.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile; gaps between component groups.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop; major layout gaps.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, inputs, small controls.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, product cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Feature cards, modals, image frames — the soft, organic edge that echoes the biophilic mood.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, avatars, the bloom-accent CTA button.
